## What's changed

- Added optional experimental HDR Enhancement for converting eligible SDR on-demand video to an HDR10 presentation on compatible Tater Tube TV players.
- Added Conservative, Balanced, and Vivid enhancement strengths, plus Auto Detect checks for the active FFmpeg and libplacebo processing path.
- Kept native HDR media, SDR-only displays, direct play, and Tube TV channels unchanged, with automatic fallback to normal SDR transcoding when enhancement is unavailable.
- Added live HDR Enhancement details to the Dashboard and Activity views, including the selected strength.
- Improved incremental and real-time local-library scans by remembering failed media probes instead of retrying unchanged files on every scan.
- Kept probe recovery automatic when a media file changes, while allowing a manual full scan to retry files after FFmpeg or access issues are corrected.
